name: Unreachable elseif
description: Flags an ElseIf whose condition can never be true because an earlier branch already covers it.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, an `ElseIf` branch whose condition can never be true because an earlier branch of the same `If` (the `If` itself or a prior `ElseIf`) already covers every value that would satisfy it (e.g. `If x > 9` followed by `ElseIf x > 10`). Only a direct relational comparison (`==`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`) between the exact same left-hand expression and a numeric literal is checked; a compound `&&`/`||` condition, a non-numeric operand, or a differently-shaped left-hand expression is left unflagged rather than guessed at.
